Question: Assalamualykum molvi sahab, i wanted to know that my name is fahed, but my frndz n all call me fahad what is the right one?? And wad is the meaning of that plz send me details abt my name (taseer) of my name. Answer ID: 21403 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 686/686/M=1431) Fahd means: leopard and panther. Fahid means: One who does somebody's work good in his absence. Both names are correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
